name: Route 44 Marshland Ponds
summary: Depart east from Mahogany Town along the serene pond highway of Route 44 leading to the foot of the Ice Mountains. Battle roadside trainers including Beauty Callie (who awards a valuable Heart Scale upon defeat) and Psychic Greg (who gifts a Full Heal). Scavenge field recovery supplies including a Max Revive and Elixir from the marshy banks, and encounter native wetland flora and fauna including wild Tangela, Weepinbell, Lickitung, and their rare fully-evolved forms Tangrowth and Lickilicky.

items.name: Heart Scale
items.method: Given by Beauty Callie after defeating her along Route 44

items.name: Full Heal
items.method: Given by Psychic Greg after defeating him along Route 44

items.name: Max Revive
items.method: Found tucked behind the marsh bushes along the north pond embankment

items.name: Elixir
items.method: Located on the secluded grass islet in the center of Route 44's main pond
